status: 2026-11-01: the initial SwiftUI shell below is retained as a fallback. The active installed phone UI is now Tauri + React with full Markdown block rendering over the same TAHMobileController and original phone-owned TAH core. Real-device reading, ASR file separation, settings and unchanged persisted publications are verified; see tools/mobile-tah/results/2026-11-01-tauri-ui-acceptance.json.

ownership.boundary: TAHFramework -> ProviderAdapter -> ProviderBackend unchanged. Main owns original AppActions/Framework in JSCore and controller; backend agent owns execution. This shell only emits typed UI intents.
ownership.choice: Initial adoption used a native SwiftUI shell; at the user's explicit request it is now superseded by apps/ios/tah-ui (Tauri + React) styled after Alma Preview. Existing presentation contracts/controller and Framework -> Adapter -> Backend remain unchanged. Historical SwiftUI implementation/evidence below are retained as provenance, not the active UI description.

version_clarification.correction: Earlier core-feature contract v1 refers to the action definition, not the v2 outcome contract seen in execution. Do not set outcomeContractID to v1. This clarification supplements that document; the original file is outside this sidecar write scope.

Transcript picker/text import, raw check/consent, Structured Notes action picker/create, output/interaction language, supplied model/effort/context choices, per-revision Web, instruction editor/send.
Public timeline with expansion/paging callbacks; accepted revisions and typed raw/notes/ASR requests; observed material sheet.

@MainActor @Observable controller, original AppActions API calls, original SQLite store.* routing, opaque provider/credential delegation, allowlisted resource reads, snapshot projection, UI index/draft persistence and normal-path polling.

host_adoption: Main adds these files to its target, retains TAHMobileController, and embeds TAHMobileView(controller:) inside NavigationStack. App entry, native provider/credential service and backend remain main/other-agent owned.

TAHMobileController implements TAHPresentationController with tracked presentation/draft. UI commands serialize admission and publish busy gates before enqueueing asynchronous calls. Main retains the controller and invokes shutdown() at runtime teardown.

Core AppActions retains authoritative authorization/receipt/catalog/policy/revision/publication validation. Controller owns UI editor-token checks, request UUIDs, local draft checkpoints, store.* routing, snapshot/history projection and coalesced normal-path polling; no role scheduling or Codex parsing.

Permissions default false. Supply all gates from controller validation; recompute send after draft edits. Set status/isBusy/error/disabledReason from real state. Busy in another action is not evidence of a raw check. Refresh is a read-only state refresh and never initiates inference.

updateDraft takes actionID+editorToken for composer edits; reject stale tokens. Nil context is only pre-action draft/consent editing. Model/provider changes normalize defaults in the controller, not in views. Unsupported saved selections remain visible as disabled values.

initialSettingsFrozen comes from AppActions; restore draft.outputLanguage from frozen action.language. Send initialLanguage only while unfrozen. canOmitInstructions comes from AppActions; UI permits blank only when true and send gate is true. Runtime still enforces nonblank later revisions, byte limits and all admission rules.

interactionLanguage is a separate app preference sampled on raw-check/send. Never infer it from transcript language or retroactively relabel historical text. settings.webEnabled maps to grantWeb for this revision, including false.

Project only public conversation/events into bounded AttributedString content (literal for user input, formatted Markdown for committed final/material). Preserve chronological journal order/stable IDs and expand by item ID. Never pass private reasoning, Guardian tool chatter or uncommitted actor finals.

revisions contains accepted publications only, keyed by commitID. configurationLabel derives provider/model/effort/context; no invented historical Web field. Controller invalidates pending material content on close/selection change and exposes only accepted outcomes.

Controller validates 48KiB chunks/constant byte counts/UTF-8 assembly; material and accepted final text use Foundation inline Markdown with preserved whitespace. Full desktop table/block Markdown fidelity remains unverified.

Text import is paste/manual entry; controller creates transcript identity and stages exact UTF-8 JSON material before check. Local form retains text across submission success/failure while mounted; no transcript transformation or fake upload is performed.
callback_map: Controller persists a local transcript/material ID index; import invokes original runtime material.put({transcriptID,materialID,title,rawTranscript}), which writes the original journal. No auto-consent/check.
action.snapshot({actionID}) + action.conversation; checkpoint previous draft first
native local draft checkpoint keyed by actionID/editorToken; not action.send

action.send({actionID:context.actionID,operationID,instructions,inference:{modelID,reasoningEffortID,contextWindowTokens?},initialLanguage?,expectedProviderID:settings.providerID,interactionLanguage,grantWeb:settings.webEnabled,consent}); validate editorToken locally; UUID generated by main

controller_handoff.initializer: try await TAHMobileController(bundleURL: URL, promptURLs: [String: URL] = [:], configurationJSON: String, journalDirectory: URL, providerPlatform: @escaping AlmaTAHJavaScriptHost.PlatformCall)
controller_handoff.bundle: Use main boot-composed generated/alma-tah.js with installed global AlmaMobileRuntime. Factory-only exports are insufficient.
controller_handoff.configuration: Passed unchanged to runtime.initialize: {profiles:[AppProviderProfile including profileIdentity],resources:{actorPromptTemplate,rawGuardianPrompt,extraGuardianPrompt,safetyPolicy},actionInstructions}. Runtime owns startup inspection.
platform: store.* decoded only as neutral TAHRuntimeValue -> original TAHJournalStore.handleRPC
resources.read({path}) accepts exact keys in promptURLs only and returns {base64}, matching platform/node-fs-promises.js
ui.actionChanged/ui.auth ACK immediately; reads coalesce separately to avoid reentrant notification deadlock
provider.* and credential.* delegate original method + opaque JSON to supplied async native closure; unknown methods rejected
controller_handoff.local_state: journalDirectory must be a canonical app-owned 0700 directory. Original store owns tah.sqlite3; controller separately owns atomic 0600 mobile-ui.json for transcript/material IDs, language preference, editor-token drafts. No cutover calls.
controller_handoff.readiness: init is async and initializes the core, then reads auth/raw/actions. refresh is read-only. inspectAuthorization() is explicit; main supplies login/provider selection outside this screen.
controller_handoff.normal_path: Import -> explicit content consent -> raw.check/status polling -> create -> mutable initial draft -> send -> core snapshot/events/history -> accepted revisions. Language/model/effort/Web follow original App fields.
limits: Provider closure receives credential traffic; controller never reads ambient credentials or parses provider wire
Exceptions and background remain deferred; shutdown awaits runtime.shutdown before closing host/journal
Full plain source file import picker and desktop Markdown renderer are not supplied
controller_handoff.coordination: Attempted authorized async main message; available thread tool rejects native-ancestor delivery and no native collaboration messenger is exposed. Requirements recorded here and returned in final.
